experiment.scope: CPU zero-update validation of the complete registered train/dev C feature package; no candidate selection or semantic score
experiment.selection: First lexicographically sorted TRAIN world; both languages, both relations and all ten pair kinds. Forty pairs per arm, eighty total. No dev gradients or test access.
experiment.package_checks: Exact match with previously frozen full inventory and prior token audit, every reply-prefix key present, full-vs-smoke overlap bit exact, verified artifact hashes and no test records
experiment.gradient_checks: Finite losses and all existing gradients; state/source/position/copy paths checked where active. Uncertainty gradients may be absent on supported-only pairs; aux factor gradients may be absent on ordinary pairs. Zero upstream gradients behind zero-initialized output matrices are expected. No optimizer.
experiment.invariants: Predicted-empty route cannot be supported; empty copy mass zero; exact disabled identity; predicted normal preserves base; predicted insufficient uses only query uncertainty; supported distributions normalized; value comparisons require identical C prefixes
experiment.failure_policy: Persist all case failures, do not silently drop pairs or change denominators. Failed integrity stops interpretation. A numerical failure blocks training until repaired and rerun; no hyperparameter search.
